ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Swaps the Tier-3 PR-review OpenRouter model from anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6 to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (ADR-167 already licenses a model switch via SHIPWRIGHT_PR_REVIEW_MODEL) and layers on a fail-closed ZDR provider-routing constraint reused from the review cascade's existing DeepSeek arm; no trust source, permission, or the free-form model-override contract is widened. A comment documenting the single-provider rollback circularity (Stage-3 doubt review, accepted-and-documented) was added next to the env var; no behavioral change.
